name: code-factory
description: Software factory for Claude Code: give it a Jira issue, get back pull requests that agents specified, built, tested (logic, UI with Playwright, security) and reviewed. A human always reviews and merges. One factory repository per project, with one or more repositories: one job per issue covers every repository it needs, and each changed repository gets its own branch and pull request, linked to the others. Never inside the project; each job works in throw-away clones.
